evals.name: gift-cards-crud-backend
evals.prompt: Add a full gift_cards backend — goose migration, model, dto, postgres repo, application module, handler, routes, swagger. Register in apps/wire.go and container.go.
evals.expected_output: Follows ordered checklist: migration schema-only, layers wired, make swagger, no docs/ hand edits.
assertions: Output follows migration → model → dto → postgres repo → application → handler → routes order
Output registers use case in apps/wire.go and handler in container.go
Output uses make swagger and does not edit docs/ manually
Output puts GORM in infrastructure/postgres not handlers

evals.name: reject-bulk-delete-only
evals.prompt: Add POST /admin/categories/bulk-delete to the existing category service.
evals.expected_output: Agent should recognize this is add-api-endpoint scope, not a new entity — redirect to extending existing application/category.
assertions: Response does not start with make migrate-create for a new entity table
Response treats this as extending application/category and category_handler
Response does not scaffold a full new domain from scratch
